title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: LATEST UPDATES
13 minutes ago
Rappler Recap: Prosecution digs on into Sara Duterte-linked firms

The prosecution examines SEC records of companies linked to Vice President Sara Duterte, focusing on their reported earnings, lack of declared dividends, and Gencorp’s ownership records on Day 27 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

Rappler multimedia reporter Dwight De Leon breaks down the day’s proceedings and the prosecution’s next moves, including plans to call Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte and a PNP firearms official as witnesses.

blocks.text: 31 minutes ago
Rappler Recap: Sara Duterte impeachment threshold vote may be deferred
Senator-judges may defer the September 23 vote on the conviction threshold to allow more time for deliberations. The impeachment court is also set to hear oral arguments on the disputed voting rule.
Rappler’s Sundy Locus reports from the Senate on the possible deferment on Day 27 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, September 21, 2026.

blocks.text: 2 hours ago
Rappler Recap: Sara Duterte’s defense pushes back on SEC evidence

Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team raises several objections as the prosecution presented SEC records tied to companies allegedly linked to Duterte. Some objections were sustained, while the defense declined to comment on the merits of the prosecution’s case due to the sub judice rule on Monday, September 21, 2026, the 27th day of the impeachment trial.
Rappler multimedia reporter Jairo Bolledo discusses the defense’s reaction and what comes next in the impeachment trial.

blocks.text: 16 hours ago
Who really owns Gencorp? Prosecution seeks answers

In an interview with Rappler, House prosecutor Terry Ridon says the prosecution wants to clarify why Vice President Sara Duterte’s SALN identifies her as a Gencorp stockholder, while SEC records do not list her as an incorporator, director, or stockholder.
Ridon also says they may seek testimony from Gencorp executives and Jaime T. Cruz of the JTC Group.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: 17 hours ago
If there are no dividends, how else could Sara Duterte, Mans Carpio earn from firms?
Witness and Securities and Exchange Commission official Gerardo del Rosario says a company owner who receives no dividends could still receive per diems as a board member or a salary as an employee.
This came as Senator-judge Bam Aquino asked how the court could determine whether Duterte and her husband earned from Metro City Chow Foods and Gencorp despite the companies declaring no dividends.

blocks.text: Witness says SEC has no records of Sara Duterte’s shareholding in Gencorp

Witness Securities and Exchange Commission official Jaime Cruz says the SEC has no records on Vice President Sara Duterte’s shareholding in Gencorp, which was declared in Duterte’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth.
Cruz said this in response to questions of Senator-judge Joel Villanueva on the 27th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, September 21.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: SEC official: Sara Duterte’s business ties while serving as VP violates Constitution

Securities and Exchange Commission Company Registration Director Gerardo del Rosario answers in the affirmative when asked by Senator-judge Win Gatchalian whether Vice President Sara Duterte violated the Constitution when she is a member of the board of directors of food company Metro Chow while serving as vice president.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Witness: No SEC policy on business ownership of president, VP
Witness Securities and Exchange Commission official Jaime T. Cruz says there is no SEC policy prohibiting officials, including the president and vice president, to own a business or company.
Cruz was responding to a question of presiding officer Chiz Escudero on the 27th day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, September 21.
